verdict.rationale: Vendor docs confirm self-service forwarding and shipping. That includes mail forwarding in plans, shipping packages to any address with bundling, requesting mail be shipped directly, and automation rules for handling mail, so the core of rule-based or request-based forwarding is present. Missing for 10: evidence that automation rules can trigger forwarding specifically, one-click forwarding, saved recipient addresses, carrier choice, cost shown before confirmation, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
